PROPOSAL DESCRIPTION: Request for use of temporary equipment. Unicom proposes to install an underground fiber optic cable and associated underground infrastructure  including overhead fiber routing on existing 37 ft AGL utility poles on and along airport ROW property. The extended height of the mobile construction equipment will be 30 ft AGL. Please see attached figure and POI description table.

The existing line is a 115 kV transmission line primarily of wooden H-Frame and mono pole structures. The proposed line will be a double circuit transmission line having a 115 kV insulated circuit  a 230 kV insulated circuit  and include a new fiber communication line. The new structures are expected to be mostly single pole wood or steel vertical construction tangent structures and two pole wood or steel vertical construction for running angle structures or dead-end structures.

PROPOSAL DESCRIPTION: The project is to regrade and pave an existing trailer lot in use by the United States Postal Service. The lot contains areas that are already paved  as well as gravel and undeveloped areas. The intent is to remove and replace material as necessary to reconstruct the paved parking lot. Tallest anticipated construction equipment on site will be an excavator with a total boom height of 20 feet. In order to assess the existing soil conditions on site  a geotechnical investigation will be performed prior to construction. To accomplish this task  a drill rig will be brought on site to drill boreholes. The drill rig to be used for this work will be the CME-850X  with a mast height of 26 feet. The soil assessment will inform the required sub-grade depth  as well as which site material can be reused. Due to the low mast height  PND Engineers does not anticipate the geotechnical work posing significant risk to air traffic in the area.
LOCATION DESCRIPTION: The United States Postal Service facility is located along Postmark Drive and lies to the east of Ted Stevens Anchorage International Airport fenced controlled secured area  and to the west of Lake Hood Seaplane Base. The area to be paved is demarcated by Lake Hood Dr to the north  Postmark Dr to the west  undeveloped forest to the east  and the existing Postal Service facility building to the south.
